name: Altaqwaa
blurb: **NOTE: Currently only supports Arabic** Free and open source Islamic desktop application that contains multiple features useful to Muslims.
description:
**NOTE: Currently only supports Arabic**

Free and open source Islamic desktop application that contains multiple features useful to Muslims. Customizable and easy to use.

• Modern interface

• The Holy Quran with text and audio

• A large collection of adhkar

• Prayer times using coordinates and time zones

• Multple methods to calculate prayer time (Umm Al-Qura, Muslim World League, and more).

• Audible notifications for adhkar and prayer times

install.label: Flatpak
install.note: Works on every distribution, sandboxed and kept up to date for you.
